verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to pass a JSON schema that constrains API output. Enrichments accept a prompt plus a list of attribute or column names, and can be built from an unspecified 'structured spec'. quick_search returns a fixed structured format. Neither is user-supplied, schema-enforced structured output, so both are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a JSON schema so the API returns structured data matching that schema
